description: TECH EAGLES is a complete five-member multidisciplinary team skilled in AI application development, full-stack engineering, front-end and back-end development, UI/UX design, data analysis, API and database integration, technical documentation, and deployment. Led by a Computer Science graduate and AI enthusiast, we combine our expertise and creativity to build innovative solutions to real-world challenges through the NASA Space Apps Challenge.
summary:
FLAMEGUARD AI is an AI-powered scientific intelligence platform designed to transform NASA’s microgravity combustion research into actionable fire-safety insights for future human space exploration.

The platform addresses the challenge of discovering, understanding, and comparing decades of space-based combustion experiments. It organizes research related to fire prevention, smoke detection, and flame suppression, helping users explore experimental conditions, investigate scientific findings, and understand their relevance to spacecraft, lunar habitats, and future Mars missions.

By combining NASA Physical Sciences Informatics (PSI) resources, structured scientific data analysis, interactive visualizations, and AI-assisted research interpretation, FLAMEGUARD AI aims to make complex combustion science more accessible, searchable, and useful.

Its vision is simple: turn scattered scientific knowledge into clearer intelligence for safer human exploration beyond Earth.
details:
Project Overview

FLAMEGUARD AI is an intelligent research and analytics platform developed to address one of the most critical challenges in human space exploration: understanding and managing fire hazards in microgravity environments.

Unlike Earth, fire behaves differently in microgravity because buoyancy-driven convection is significantly reduced. Flame shape, heat transfer, oxygen transport, smoke movement, and combustion behavior can therefore differ considerably from familiar terrestrial conditions. Understanding these differences is essential for protecting astronauts aboard spacecraft, space stations, lunar habitats, and future Mars missions.

How It Works

FLAMEGUARD AI brings relevant NASA combustion research into a unified scientific intelligence environment. Its research framework focuses on three essential pillars of spacecraft fire safety:

  1. Fire Prevention: Exploring material flammability, fuel characteristics, oxygen concentration, airflow, and experimental combustion conditions through investigations such as BASS, BASS-II, and Saffire.
  2. Fire Detection: Examining smoke and aerosol measurement research, particularly SAME and SAME-R, to help researchers understand the science behind fire detection in microgravity.
  3. Fire Suppression: Exploring flame extinguishment research, including FLEX and FLEX-2, to investigate suppression mechanisms and their relevance to spacecraft safety.

The platform is designed to organize scientific information, support investigation discovery and comparison, visualize experimental parameters, and use AI-assisted interpretation to make complex research more accessible.

Artificial Intelligence and Innovation

FLAMEGUARD AI integrates an AI-assisted research approach that can interpret scientific information, summarize investigations, answer research questions, and connect findings with relevant experimental evidence.

Its central innovation is combining scientific research discovery, comparative analytics, and mission-oriented fire-safety intelligence within one platform rather than requiring researchers to navigate disconnected publications and datasets.

Intended Impact

The project aims to support aerospace researchers, engineers, students, and space mission designers by improving access to combustion science and helping identify research relevant to safer crew environments.

It also explores how knowledge developed for space fire safety can contribute to terrestrial applications, including improved smoke detection, fire suppression technologies, and material safety research.

Technology and Development

The proposed technical architecture combines a modern web application frontend, a Python-based backend, structured scientific data processing, database storage, interactive data visualization, and Google Gemini-powered AI capabilities.

NASA Physical Sciences Informatics (PSI) is the primary scientific research resource. The development approach emphasizes research traceability, scientific accuracy, transparent AI interpretation, and clear separation between experimental findings and hypothetical scenarios.

What Makes FLAMEGUARD AI Different?

FLAMEGUARD AI transforms the way people interact with space combustion research. Instead of simply displaying scientific documents, its vision is to connect research findings with practical mission-safety questions.

By turning complex microgravity combustion knowledge into accessible scientific intelligence, FLAMEGUARD AI contributes toward a future in which every research insight can help make human exploration of space safer.
